issues.content:
Issue: MCP-150
Summary: Migrate MCP Gateway from Auth API v1 to v2
Type: Story
Status: Done
Assignee: Mira Sen
Reporter: Dev Mehta
Labels: migration, authentication, breaking-change

Description:
MCP Gateway migration to Auth API v2 is complete. MCP now consumes POST /v2/auth and no longer uses POST /v1/auth. Documentation was updated before the production repository snapshot was verified.

Comment by Dev Mehta:
Marking complete based on the migration review. Repository evidence should be checked separately.
